key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline priced complexity as a ledger (six observations bought with three touchable entities vs >=5 unverified ghost entities, falsifier per mechanism, cheapest probe first) while the non-routed v5 AI reached the same fix but carried the paranormal hypothesis unpriced through WHY/HOW. The routed m004 pass closed that gap: simplest hypothesis stated, complexity charge quantified (what must be true for the ghost to win), orphan-observation audit for all six items, and probe ordering derived from the price ledger; the m003 inversion gate added >=6 ranked failure categories with a never/always reframing. Residual gap: the human's single continuous parsimony chain is stylistically leaner than the routed packet's modular trace; the splice-heat attribution remains the one unverified item for both sides.
learning_signal: Parsimony wins when it is executed as an auditable price ledger, not a preference: enumerate the entities each hypothesis invokes, require a mechanism or an explicit unverified flag for every observation, quantify what the complex explanation must add to win, and order probes by cost within the ledger. When a single simple hypothesis spans multiple named mechanisms (neutral lug + duct expansion + splice), the parsimony unit is unobserved entities, not named causes — a multi-cause simple story with zero unobserved entities and zero interaction terms is not a parsimony violation.
suggested_improvement: Make the m004 pass (simplest-hypothesis-stated + complexity-charge-quantified + orphan audit + multi-cause check) a standing completion contract for diagnose/estimate signatures with a dominant measured signature, and keep the m003 inversion gate on guarantee-goals: it converts parsimony into an efficiency rule (probe first) and a social-close rule (demonstration the other model can verify, never argument).

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-Occam baseline (registry's documented weakness: under-explains multi-cause phenomena) selected the newest salient change (the new insert) as the single cause and paid off the two killer facts as background drift — presses 1-3 rose 1.7->5.3 with no equipment change and press 4 was already rising 1.9->2.4 pre-install — so its single fix would leave ~80% of the defect rate in place. The routed dual-route avoided the trap entirely (trap style out of top-3): m018 steel-manned the manager's story into its strongest form and then showed it self-refutes on the cross-press series, m015's additivity check proved the four causes are additive and independent (no interaction term owed, residual <0.2), and the m019 context pass priced the expensive-misdiagnosis path as the adversary's exploit. Residual gap: the routed run costs one extra pass vs the human's cheap (wrong) single-cause answer on efficiency.
learning_signal: Parsimony is valid only against the full evidence surface: before any single-cause explanation is accepted, run a cause-scope check (a localized cause cannot produce a population-wide effect), a pre-event trend check (was the cause rising before it arrived?), and a coverage check (every evidence item assigned or flagged). When multiple candidates survive, complexity is not a luxury but a requirement — the correct model is the smallest one that accounts for every series as a quantified partition summing to the observed effect, with a measurement-change check (definitional shifts) run before cause hunting.
suggested_improvement: Keep the dual-route m015+m018 on ambiguous diagnose/estimate signatures with a salient single-cause claim present: steel-manning gives the narrative the plant manager can adopt (the strongest version of their story is shown self-refuting), and the emergence/additivity check bounds the partition against over-complexification. Add the cause-scope and pre-event-trend checks to the WHY gate as standing falsifiers for any single-cause story, and accept the one-pass efficiency cost as the price of a partition that survives every evidence item.
